required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous failed round correctly identified as decision_20260708_state_domain_taxonomy_closeout_evidence_rework_v1?
Does command-plan still include an explicit pytest command?
Does pytest_result.txt still include direct pytest output, exit code 0, and test count?
Does report-summary synthesis match execution_report and codex_execution_report?
Does execution-log cover all executed commands?
Does final_gate_result.json gate_status support the report status?
Does final_gate_result.json status_summary support the report status and acceptance recommendation?
Does run_closeout_result.json close_round_result.report_status match execution_report and codex_execution_report?
Does round_manifest.json report_status match execution_report and codex_execution_report?
If final_gate_result.json is WARN, do reports avoid unqualified SUCCESS / ACCEPTED?
If status_summary is PARTIAL / NEEDS_REVIEW, do reports avoid unqualified SUCCESS / ACCEPTED?
If close_round_result.report_status is PARTIAL, do reports avoid unqualified SUCCESS / ACCEPTED?
If all reports claim SUCCESS / ACCEPTED, is final_gate_result.json free of active WARN/PARTIAL/NEEDS_REVIEW status?
Are non-blocking historical warnings explicitly classified as historical/non-blocking?
Are current active warnings either resolved or reflected as ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS / REWORK_REQUIRED?
Were current_state.json and task_packet.json left untouched?
Were artifact_index.json, negative_results.json, state_manifest.json, context/*, roadmap/workstreams.json, and domains/* left untouched?
Were User Solve, Evidence Replay, Web, tools, runner, database, cleanup, and sample solving avoided?
Were all generated artifacts current for this decision_id and round_id?
Are stale failed-round artifacts treated only as failure evidence, not current acceptance evidence?
Do codex_execution_report.md and execution_report.md agree on report_id, decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, files_changed, tests_ran, and generated_artifacts?
Does close-round generate the final-status rework round manifest?
Does round_manifest status agree with live reports and final_gate status_summary?
Does run-closeout avoid wrapping active WARN/PARTIAL/NEEDS_REVIEW into ACCEPTED?
Is the final recommendation one of ACCEPTED, ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS, REWORK_REQUIRED, or BLOCKED, and is it supported by evidence?
